verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM runtime, so launching third-party coding agents against local models is a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents its own `--cli` chat mode, a local HTTP server and Web UI, and running pre-built model files. Nothing shows a command that launches or pre-configures external coding agent CLIs, and the generic local server is at most a building block.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
